source_rights.date_precision: Exact day. The Nationaal Archief record gives dcterms_date 1983-06-10 (reportage: Chief Mangosuthu Gatsha Buthelezi arriving at Schiphol). Commons extmetadata DateTimeOriginal is 1983-06-10 and the file page gives Datum '10 juni 1983'.
source_rights.rights_statement: Retained source statement: CC0 (Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal), rights holder Nationaal Archief. Anefo is the historical Dutch photo agency whose collection the Nationaal Archief holds and has released under CC0; this is an archival public-domain dedication, not a live press-agency licence.
source_rights.age_gap_note: Photograph of 10 June 1983: 4,223 days (about 11.6 years) before the window's first day (1995-01-01) and 7,875 days (about 21.6 years) before its last day (2004-12-31). Buthelezi was born on 27 August 1928 (general biographical knowledge, not C01 research; the registry has no birth date): South African History Online, https://sahistory.org.za/people/chief-mangosuthu-gatsha-buthelezi ('Born 27 August 1928', checked at assembly on 2026-10-01), and Wikidata Q554131 P569 1928-08-27. He is 54 in the photograph and 66 to 76 in the window. The prompt asks for a man of about 70 with the same features, glasses and beard shape, a slightly fuller and softer face, a few lines, and moderate salt-and-pepper grey in hair, moustache and beard, and says this older treatment and the grey are artistic interpretations, not attested by a dated 1995-2004 photograph. Colours are artistic because the photograph is black and white.
source_rights.limitation: The reference is 11.6 to 21.6 years before the window. Searched: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Mangosuthu Buthelezi, full-text 'Buthelezi' and 'Mangosuthu OR Gatsha', depicts P180=Q554131), web searches and the sibling agent's Openverse and Flickr result files; the verifier searched the George H. W. Bush Library digital research room; the assembler fetched NARA catalog record 543950122. In those sources no qualifying single-subject photograph from 1984 to 2004 was found. Closer public-domain US federal material exists only as Bush White House contact sheets of 28 February 1990 and 20 June 1991, which cannot be used unchanged (see rejected candidates); Commons also holds two Carter White House staff photographs of 5 May 1977 (Public domain), further from the window than 1983. The EC Audiovisual Service was not searched (JavaScript-only search page).

source_rights.date_precision: Month only. The Commons description reads 'Constand Viljoen in September 1984' and the Flickr parent caption places it at P. W. Botha's inauguration as State President in September 1984. The Commons/Flickr 'Date' 2011-07-24 23:03:28 is the scan or upload timestamp, not the photograph date. Ian Barbour's two captions disagree on when he was Viljoen's driver (1984 or 1985); the event date is unaffected.
source_rights.rights_statement: Retained source statement: CC BY-SA 2.0, author Ian Barbour. Barbour's sibling Flickr caption (5971221735, same event) says he was General Viljoen's driver and sat in the front row, which supports that he took these photographs himself. Registration must explicitly offer the cartoon adaptation and any copyrightable contributions under CC BY-SA 2.0, retain attribution and identify the adaptation; a generated label and source licence alone do not record this obligation.
source_rights.age_gap_note: Viljoen was born on 28 October 1933 (general biographical knowledge, not C01 research; the registry has no birth date): Wikidata Q2568741 P569 1933-10-28, checked at assembly on 2026-10-01. He was about 50 in the September 1984 photograph and 60 to 67 across the window (1994-03-31 to 2000-12-31). The photograph is about 9.5 years before the window starts and about 16.3 years before it ends; the prompt discloses this and asks for a man of 60 to 67 with deeper lines around the eyes and mouth, keeping the same face structure and silver-white hair. The cap hides his crown, so the hair above the temples is an artistic interpretation; the open eyes, civilian suit, standing body, hands, trousers and shoes are artistic extensions of a small head-and-collar crop. The military cap, badge and uniform are explicitly excluded.
source_rights.limitation: Small (383x388), month-dated crop taken 9.5 to 16 years before the window, in military dress, three-quarter view with downcast eyes, with a partial second face at the top-left edge. No qualifying 1994-2000 photograph was found on Commons, Openverse, the NARA catalog (14 textual records only) or the Clinton Digital Library.

source_rights.date_precision: Day stated in the Commons/Flickr description ('in Johannesburg, South Africa on Sep. 16, 2013') and in the embedded EXIF DateTimeOriginal 2013:09:16 09:14:34 (Nikon D600); the two agree.
source_rights.rights_statement: Retained source statement: CC BY 2.0 as published by the U.S. Department of Agriculture on its official Flickr stream and confirmed by Commons FlickrReview (Gbawden) on 2013-09-19. The embedded EXIF Copyright reads 'by BWPeventphotography.co.za': the photograph was taken by a Johannesburg event photographer for the USDA trade mission and released by USDA; it is not a wire-agency or press photograph. Not treated as a public-domain US federal work.
source_rights.age_gap_note: Photograph of 16 September 2013, inside the window: 4,470 days (about 12.2 years) after the window start 2001-06-21 and 1,153 days (about 3.2 years) before its last day 2016-11-12. Mulder was born on 26 July 1951 (general biographical knowledge, not C01 research: Wikidata Q770995 P569 1951-07-26, checked at assembly on 2026-10-01; English and Afrikaans Wikipedia per the verifier). He is 62 in the photograph and 49 to 65 across the window. The prompt asks for a man in his late fifties (about 57, the middle of the period), about five years younger than the photograph, keeping the photographed gray hair, glasses and full face. The 2001-12-31 to 2005-01-01 leadership job (ages 50 to 53) relies on de-ageing of about 9 to 12 years; his hair may have been less gray then, but no qualifying earlier photograph exists to check, so the prompt invents no other hair colour. The standing body below the chest, hands, trousers and shoes are artistic extensions of a waist-up lectern photograph.
source_rights.limitation: A single qualifying photograph from late in a 15.4-year window; no 2001-2012 or 2014-2016 photograph of Mulder with a FREE_LICENSES licence string was found on Commons. GovernmentZA/GCIS Flickr was not searched in this pass (its photographs are usually CC BY-ND).

The closest photographs that pass the licence and date rules are the Anefo frames of 10 June 1983 (CC0), 21.6 years before the window starts and 36.2 years before it ends (age 54 against 76 to 90; born 27 August 1928, general biographical knowledge). Drawing him at 76 to 90 from them would invent most of his late-life appearance, so the window was not prepared.

No qualifying likeness photograph of Hlabisa exists in the sources searched. Commons holds only an eNCA YouTube video still (2019-05-13, CC BY 3.0) and its crop, rejected as TV stills; every Flickr photograph of him is ND, NC-ND or all rights reserved.

No qualifying likeness photograph of Meshoe was found for this window or any other date in the sources searched (Commons, Openverse, Flickr with free-licence filters, NARA catalog and Library of Congress). Commons holds only video stills.

No qualifying likeness photograph exists for 2010-2026. The only in-window images on Commons are video frames (a 2013 or 2014 Vimeo screenshot and a 2019 YouTube still, both 'CC BY 3.0'), which the batch rejects; the ideal dated GovernmentZA solo photograph (2025-02-06) is CC BY-ND 2.0.
